# AL Noor Solar Energy - LLM Directory & Information

> AL Noor Solar Energy is the leading solar solutions provider in Multan and South Punjab, Pakistan.

## About AL Noor Solar Energy
AL Noor Solar Energy provides Tier-1 solar photovoltaic panels, smart on-grid and hybrid solar inverters, lithium battery energy storage systems, agricultural solar tube-well solutions, and turnkey MEPCO WAPDA Net Metering installations.

- **Website**: https://al-noorsolarenergy.com/
- **Location**: 155 A, Opposite Bank Alfalah, Model Town Chowk, Multan, Punjab, Pakistan
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 300 6771013
- **Leadership**: Engr. Muhammad Hamid (CEO)
- **Business Hours**: Saturday – Thursday (9:00 AM – 7:00 PM), Friday Closed

## Core Offerings & Products
1. **Solar Inverters**: Knox Inverters, Solis Hybrid & On-Grid, GoodWe, Growatt, Huawei Solar, Inverex Solar.
2. **Solar Panels**: Tier-1 N-Type and Bi-Facial Panels from Longi Solar (Hi-MO 6/7), JA Solar, Canadian Solar (TopBiHiKu), and Trina Solar (Vertex N).
3. **Energy Storage**: High-cycle LiFePO4 Lithium Solar Battery Banks.
4. **Agricultural Solar**: Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) solar pumping systems (7.5kW to 37kW+) for tube wells and turbines.
5. **Net Metering**: Turnkey MEPCO Net Metering document preparation, NEPRA compliance, and green meter installation.
